source: Lance's first-step copy, Nov 14 2026, one line per library record

firstSteps.video-canva: Drop your existing clips into a video project and trim them into a 15-second rough cut.
firstSteps.video-runway: Pick one reference image and test a short clip with one specific camera move.
firstSteps.video-elevenlabs: Paste two lines of your script and preview them in a voice that fits your audience.
firstSteps.photos-canva: Open a design at the size you need and place your existing logo or photo before arranging the text.
firstSteps.photos-runway: Start with one reference image and describe a single visual change to try.
firstSteps.writing-chatgpt: Paste your rough notes and say who the piece is for and what you want them to do after reading it.
firstSteps.writing-claude: Share your draft and ask where a first-time reader would get lost.
firstSteps.mvp-floot: Describe one user task and the information the app needs to remember after the user finishes it.
firstSteps.mvp-base44: Describe the first screen and the one action a user should be able to complete there.
firstSteps.mvp-replit: Start with one small runnable version of the core interaction, then try it with sample data.
firstSteps.website-squarespace: Pick the page getting the most visits and check on your phone how easy it is to find and use the sign-up form.
firstSteps.website-floot: Describe the public page and what should happen after someone signs up, such as creating an account or saving their preferences.
